The '''1945–46 [[La Liga]]''' was the 15th season since its establishment. [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] achieved their first title ever, secured with a 1–1 draw on the final matchday away to [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], their direct rivals for the championship who would have taken the trophy with a win.<ref name="First time">{{cite news|title=Last day drama in Spain|publisher=ESPN|author=Michael Yokhin|date=16 May 2014|url=http://www.espnfc.com/blog/_/name/laliga/id/1879?cc=5901|access-date=21 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140520075734/http://www.espnfc.com/blog/_/name/laliga/id/1879 |archive-date=20 May 2014}}</ref>
